anti_overlap: Focus on operational reliability and observability, not routing policy (fd-heterogeneous-fleet-cost-routing) or prompt format (fd-prompt-portability-across-families)
decision_lens: When OpenRouter returns a 500 or times out at 45s into a 60s agent run, does the system degrade gracefully or corrupt the review?
focus: Failure handling, timeout management, and cost audit trail for the OpenRouter HTTP backend
name: fd-api-resilience-and-observability
persona: An SRE who has operated multi-provider API gateways at scale and knows that the provider you trust least will fail during your most important review
review_areas: Timeout management: OpenRouter has different latency profiles than Claude's Agent tool — how do agent timeouts adapt?
Retry policy: which failures are retryable (rate limit, timeout) vs terminal (auth failure, model unavailable)?
Partial failure propagation: if 2/6 agents fail on OpenRouter, does synthesis produce a valid partial result or abort?
Cost audit trail: per-agent cost tracking across providers for sprint budget enforcement and interstat recording
Rate limiting and concurrency: OpenRouter has per-key rate limits — how does parallel dispatch of 6+ agents avoid 429s?

severity_examples.condition: When parallel dispatch exceeds per-key concurrent request limit without backoff
severity_examples.scenario: OpenRouter rate limit (429) causes all parallel agents to fail simultaneously, producing zero findings

severity_examples.condition: When timeout config doesn't account for OpenRouter's higher latency variance
severity_examples.scenario: Timeout mismatch: OpenRouter agent takes 90s but flux-watch.sh times out at 60s, marking it failed when it would have succeeded

severity_examples.condition: When token-count.py only parses Claude JSONL format, not OpenRouter response JSON
severity_examples.scenario: Cost data from OpenRouter not recorded in interstat, making budget estimates progressively wrong

success_hints: Look for provider-aware timeout config, retry with exponential backoff, concurrent request limiting, and unified cost recording across providers
task_context: Interflux currently has no external API calls — all agents run inside Claude Code's sandbox. OpenRouter adds a new failure domain.
